en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Ali Majluwayh who said it was narrated to me by my uncle Muhammad b. Abi al-Qasim from Muhammad b. Ali al-Kufi from al-Muffadhal b. Salih al-Asadi from Muhammad b. Harun from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
If I am mentioned in someone’s presence and he does not recite durood, he has lost the way of Paradise.”
